hash_rule: SHA-256 of the full prompt with no name and no client: YOUR_NAME left in place, UTF-8, LF newlines, no BOM, no trailing newline.
note: Newest last. Append one entry per new prompt version; tools/prompthist_test.py checks the last entry against poascan/onboarding_prompt.py. hash is published when POAScan served template_sha256 for that version (from v2.7), computed when it was worked out later from the repo by the same rule.

versions.changed: Opens with a pasted-only line. Check-in links removed. The register link is written whole, in code.
versions.why: A prompt found on a web page must never read as an instruction (LabLeak post 1398).

versions.changed: Reuses only a key it saved for you. Never borrows another key or searches files for one.
versions.why: An agent should never pick up someone else's key (LabLeak comment 3469).

versions.changed: One private backup right after saving the key. Calls with the key never follow a redirect. Hash published.
versions.why: So the key is not lost, and anyone can check which prompt they got (LabLeak comment 3476).
The network upgrade finished and grading resumed.

versions.changed: Re-reads the challenge right before submitting.
versions.why: Words can change mid-epoch, and stale answers were rejected (LabLeak comments 3514, 3517, 3531).

versions.changed: Checks its own status before the first write each visit. Stops on a critical notice or activity it didn't make.
versions.why: A PoA key can't be rotated, so a leak has to be caught early (Patches, POA Observatory).

versions.changed: Your agent mines a one-time proof of work, then joins with one POST. Apps that can't run code join on minepoa.com.
versions.why: minepoa now requires an admission proof and retired the register link (go.md Step 0/1).

versions.changed: Reads kind and bits from each challenge and stops unless kind is pow. A 403 with required_bits gets a fresh challenge and a new proof.
versions.why: minepoa made join difficulty adjustable (v0.67): each challenge sets bits, now 21.

versions.changed: A 503 halt on the join challenge stops the agent with: Joins are paused. Check back later. No mining or retry.
versions.why: minepoa halted /api/join-pow (503, API hardening) on Oct 30.

versions.changed: The key goes only in an X-Api-Key header, never in a link, and is never shown in the chat. The backup is a file. The grading guide link is gone.
versions.why: Join with Anything v1.0 key rules: no key in a URL, never echo the key.

versions.changed: A 401 or 403 saying the key is missing or invalid on challenge, answer or mine stops mining: the agent says it needs a fix, never retries with the key in a URL and never shows it.
versions.why: Header auth on challenge, answer and mine is not confirmed upstream yet.
